evidence.claim: Card C12265-K2 shows past local confirmed fraud cases CC-2277 and CC-2447 involving mixed-channel activity and unrecognized transactions. The transaction history includes in_person transactions on 2016-10-02, 2016-12-10, and 2016-12-11 with low risk scores (0.17 to 0.25). The trigger context references an online transaction (txn 3509359) for $125.08 scored at 0.52 on 2016-12-03.

case.summary: Card C12265-K2 shows past local confirmed fraud cases CC-2277 and CC-2447 involving mixed-channel activity and unrecognized transactions. The transaction history includes in_person transactions on 2016-10-02, 2016-12-10, and 2016-12-11 with low risk scores (0.17 to 0.25). The trigger context references an online transaction (txn 3509359) for $125.08 scored at 0.52 on 2016-12-03.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card.

initial.reason: Moderate fraud probability (0.65) with account takeover pattern and mixed-channel activity warrants step-up authentication for the online transaction.

final.reason: Customer confirmed they did not make the purchases and still have the card, verifying card compromise and account takeover. With exposure below $2,500 ($125.08), BLOCK_CARD on route L1 is mandated.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer validation confirmed unauthorized purchases, escalating the action from step-up authentication to blocking the compromised card.

sar.reason: No structured SAR decision was requested.
